description: Details pursuant to condition 6 (Front garden details), of Variation of Condition application  reference 24/2821 dated 05/12/2025 for Variation of condition 2 (Approved drawing(s) and/or documents(s)) to allow; Omission of single-storey rear extension, New window to ground floor, Omission of rooflight at second floor, Omission of double doors into bedroom 6, Retention of existing roof and dormers, Enlargement of existing rooflights, Living room window replaced with door, Retention of W22, Retention of W17, Enlargement of W20, Reference change to W09 and Amended drawing titles of Householder planning permission reference 23/2072 dated 08/09/2023  for Demolition of existing conservatory and erection of new single storey rear extension with green roof, new main roof construction, single storey outbuilding in rear garden, replacement of cladding to dormer windows and removal of existing dormers, alteration to fenestration, refurbishment or replacement of existing windows and doors, addition of ventilation cowls to all chimneys pots, alteration to front boundary wall with new gates, provision for cycle and refuse storage and landscaping  to dwellinghouse.
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
